purpose: A daily briefing of what changed in the tech stacks you follow: releases, security advisories and posts from each project's own team, most important first.

screens.says: Today's briefing: what changed in the stacks you follow, in four groups (Act on it, Notable releases, Worth reading, routine updates), ending with You're caught up.

states.empty: Asks you to choose the stacks you work with, with popular ones to follow in one tap.
states.loading: Shows the last briefing, or placeholder rows the very first time.
states.offline: Shows the last briefing with the time it was fetched.
states.error: Says the feed couldn't be reached, keeps the last briefing and offers Try again.

screens.says: One item: its summary, its badges, why it's in your briefing and a link to the source.
Search the curated list of stacks by name or alias, follow and unfollow them, and request one that isn't there.

states.empty: When a search finds nothing, offers to request the stack on GitHub.
states.loading: Placeholder rows while the list loads.
states.offline: Shows the list from last time.
states.error: Says the list of stacks couldn't be loaded and offers Try again.

keeps.what: The version of the saved data, for moving it forward when the app changes
The ids of the stacks you follow
When you last opened the app and which items you opened, to know what's new
The last list of stacks and the last items for the stacks you follow, for offline use

steps.text: Open the app for the first time and see a prompt to choose stacks
Search the list for a stack by name or alias
Follow a stack and see it counted as followed
See what changed in my stacks, grouped into Act on it, Notable releases, Worth reading and routine updates
Open an item to see its summary and why it's in my briefing
Find the link to the item's source
Search for a stack that isn't in the list and see the offer to request it
See the link to the request form on GitHub
See what's wrong and a way to try again, with the last briefing kept when there is one

promises.text: The stacks you follow stay followed when the app is closed or updated.
Security advisories and breaking changes always come first in the briefing.

network.why: To get the curated list of stacks and the latest items for the stacks you follow, which this app's feed publishes there every 6 hours.
network.sends: The names of the stacks you follow

network.why: Opens the form to request a stack that isn't in the list, only when you tap Request it.
network.sends: Nothing; the form opens in your browser

design.notes: CloudCrane UI kit for controls, plus a small feed layer: item rows, badges, stack monograms. Red is for security only.
